name: branchline
description: A focused, LLM-assisted Git branch workspace.
author: Branchline

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/prepare-electron-build.mjs && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && node scripts/prepare-electron-build.mjs --copy
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run icons && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run icons && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run icons && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run icons && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run icons && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --linux
